regime_context: Detector shows a very narrow, one-narrative regime in China A-shares: Coal is the sole eligible leader (durability 0.55, mean-revert tag), with Banks the only other eligible theme and crowded/trending. Absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false) and backtest verdict is 'discipline_not_prediction', so the detector is display-only here; the only callable leg is focus/coincident texture, not forward edge. Track record dir_accuracy is 0.348 with n=92, so convictions should be low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Coal's mean-revert tag and 0.55 durability bar lead to a handoff toward Banks; the observable I'm watching for is Coal losing eligible status (score falling below Banks) or Banks' crowding_z reverting below ~1.0 while still holding breadth >0.8 — either would retire this watch as a confirmed rotation instead of a hypothesis.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the lone eligible leader with positive score and one-narrative dominance, but its hurst tag is mean-revert and durability is only 0.55, just above bar. The only reason to lean overweight is continuation of present narrative concentration while the trend-gate itself is not validated on this market, so this is a mechanical expression of the current focus lens, not an edge claim.
theses.dissent: As a mean-reverting tape, Coal's leadership is exactly the kind of whipsaw that the absolute-trend gate historically failed to protect against, and a 0.55 durability bar is marginal — rotation into Banks is already visible with a 0.212 margin.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS underperforms CSI 300 by 5% before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the challenger with high durability (0.84) and full breadth (1.0), but crowding_z 1.81 flags it as crowded. The guardrails forbid fading the leader on crowding, but this is an avoid lean on the crowded challenger, not a fade of Coal. With the trend-gate not validated here and dir_accuracy poor, no positive lean is justified despite attractive durability.
theses.dissent: Banks has the strongest durability and breadth in the whole table — if a rotation materializes and Coal's mean-revert tape snaps, Banks is the natural absorber and its crowding is not a documented sell signal.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS outperforms CSI 300 by 8% while Coal underperforms by 5% before the 20-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
